# Keyboard shortcuts
{: .no_toc }

Shortcuts in Substratal for Linux. Every shortcut has a visible equivalent: a button, menu item or the command palette. Press **Ctrl+?** in the app to see this list.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }


## General

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl+K</kbd> | Command palette |
| <kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd> | Search |
| <kbd>F1</kbd> | Help for this screen |
| <kbd>Ctrl+,</kbd> | Preferences |
| <kbd>Ctrl+?</kbd> | Keyboard shortcuts |
| <kbd>Ctrl+W</kbd> | Close window |
| <kbd>Ctrl+Q</kbd> | Quit |

## Navigation

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Alt+1</kbd> | Home |
| <kbd>Alt+2</kbd> | Inbox |
| <kbd>Alt+3</kbd> | Organizations |
| <kbd>Alt+4</kbd> | Account |
| <kbd>Alt+5</kbd> | Plan & Billing |
| <kbd>Alt+6</kbd> | Settings |
| <kbd>Alt+←</kbd> | Back |
| <kbd>F9</kbd> | Show or hide the sidebar |

## Editing

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl+N</kbd> | New (in the current list) |
| <kbd>Ctrl+R</kbd> or <kbd>F5</kbd> | Refresh |
| <kbd>Ctrl+Z</kbd> | Undo an access change |
| <kbd>Delete</kbd> | Delete or turn off the selection (asks first) |
| <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+U</kbd> | Mark all as read (Inbox) |
